text: This subsystem MUST NOT block the presentation layer or run synchronous file I/O on the main IPC thread.
All PII/PHI shall be encrypted at rest at the field level (Fernet AES-128-CBC).
The system shall provide a health endpoint that reports whether the API is responding.
Every read or write of PHI shall produce one immutable AuditLog entry.
Tests shall cover the shield, profiler, planner, loss estimator, executor, packaging, API, and enterprise flows.
The system shall convert the LLM response text to speech in the appropriate language.
Role changes shall be logged in the audit trail (actor, target user, old role set, new role set, timestamp).
Each persisted event shall be assigned a monotonically increasing, per-aggregate integer version number starting at 1.
The system shall not transmit any student data to external servers.
AggregateRoot shall maintain a list of uncommitted (in-memory) events raised since the last load or snapshot restore.
The system shall degrade to a defined, observable "offline" state rather than an undefined one when recovery is exhausted.
Users shall be able to search variables by key.
MFA (TOTP) shall be enforced for all clinical and admin roles in production.
EnvLens must not make network requests during normal operation.
Hiding a button in the frontend shall not be considered sufficient authorization.
Identifiers and emails shall not receive fabricated null replacements.
Possessing a general permission must not automatically grant access to every record.
System shall support batch content creation
The system must minimize intrusiveness and avoid posting in public channels by default.
The system shall never attempt to disable DC3 (the rail powering the ESP32 itself).
All interactions MUST use parameterized positional binding (? or :param).
Each I2C transaction shall itself time out (10 ms) at the ESP-IDF driver level (i2c_master_cmd_begin), returning I2C_ERR_BUS on failure rather than hanging.
System shall support manual verification workflow
AggregateRoot shall maintain an integer version property, initialised to 0, that increments by 1 each time an event is applied.
Plans shall be simulated before durable execution.
Tests must run in any order without interference
The system shall validate required fields and reject invalid input.
EnvLens shall detect malformed dotenv lines and show warnings.
After a successful re-init, the system shall immediately perform a verification read before resuming normal operation.
The system shall enforce publish gates for High-stakes candidates by default: Verified status required unless a facilitator explicitly overrides with a written rationale and "UNCONFIRMED" labeling.
An episode from Series B MUST NEVER chain into an active session from Series A, regardless of temporal proximity.
Creating an encounter shall automatically open a TreatmentRelationship for future access.
The system shall provide i2c_init() to configure the ESP32 I2C master peripheral (SDA=GPIO21, SCL=GPIO22, 400kHz) before any device communication.
API responses shall use consistent JSON structures and appropriate HTTP status codes.
The Users shall be able to filter results by price and flying class.
The system shall compute a readiness state for each COP Candidate: (a) Ready — Verified, (b) Ready — In Review, or (c) Blocked.
Inter-register-write delay during BMA423 configuration shall be ≥1000 μs, using a busy-wait, not a tick-based delay.
The planner shall support local SLM reasoning without making it mandatory.
Users shall be able to search flights by destination, date, class, etc.
The backend shall not expose stack traces, passwords, tokens, database credentials, or other sensitive implementation details in client-facing errors.
Passwords shall be stored using a suitable password-hashing algorithm and never as plain text.
The system shall detect probable duplicate patients at registration using EMPI matching on national ID and name+DOB.
These endpoints must not be exposed as a publicly deployed, unrestricted service.
A resolved request must include resolution notes.
The system shall accept CSV, TSV/TAB, Parquet, JSON, NDJSON, and JSONL input.
Register addresses, bit positions, and bit masks shall be defined as named constants, not magic numbers, at call sites.
The append operation shall accept an expected_version integer parameter.
Frontend-backend communication shall use REST APIs.
The append operation shall write events atomically: either all events in a single call are persisted or none are (all-or-nothing transaction).

When generating draft COP line items with In-Review status, the system shall apply hedged phrasing consistent with CDD Appendix A (e.g., "Reports indicate...," "Unconfirmed: ...," "Seeking confirmation of...").
Every Beta endpoint shall define its required authentication, permission scope, role restrictions, and resource-level access checks in the TDD.
When supplied, only events whose version number is strictly greater than after_version shall be returned.
The system shall follow a modular architecture with clear separation of concerns.
A data-retention policy with configurable TTL shall be enforced.
The library shall provide an AggregateRoot base class.
System shall provide complete workflow for creating wiki guides
A dedicated FreeRTOS task shall block on the event queue and perform the actual accelerometer read upon event receipt.
The system shall load configuration from a YAML file and environment variables.
The library shall be packaged with a pyproject.toml (PEP 517/518).
Quarantined input and validation failures shall remain inspectable through logs or report metadata.
The System shall provide offline access to booking history and e-tickets.

The system shall fully complete and verify BMA423 hardware configuration (bma423_init()) before installing the GPIO ISR and starting the acquisition task (bma423_isr_init()) — hardware must be known-good before interrupts are allowed to fire against it.
The system shall validate required fields and reject invalid input with a descriptive error response.
The System shall contain different flight categories for different purposes of air travel.
The system shall convert captured audio to text in the detected language.
The semantic typer shall reject low-confidence predictions.
The load operation shall return events in ascending version order.
Clinical workflows must not be delayed.
The version number shall be stored alongside the event and returned when events are loaded.
The TUI shall support keyboard navigation.
Users shall be able to register, log in, and securely access their account.

The system shall record and make available to facilitators the following operational metrics: (a) time-to-validated-update (first signal → Ready — Verified), (b) conflicting-report rate, (c) moderator burden (facilitator actions per COP update cycle), (d) provenance coverage (% of published line items with complete evidence packs), and (e) readiness distribution (COP Candidates by state).
EnvLens shall calculate an effective value according to precedence rules.
Users shall be able to cancel or reschedule bookings via their dashboard.
The Users shall be able to search flights by destination, date, class, etc.
This subsystem MUST NOT parse media stream contents or execute video decoding logic.
The application shall provide understandable validation and error messages without exposing sensitive internal details.
Users shall be able to select seat, baggage, and add-on services.
Content creators shall follow front-loading guidelines for optimal card display
The API shall enforce role-based authorization.
This subsystem MUST NOT link dynamically or statically against libvlc; it interacts solely via standard OS process controls and the official HTTP interface.
The system shall wait a fixed settling period (50 ms) after soft reset before further register access, per datasheet reboot timing.
Executables must verify as valid filesystem binaries with .exe extension (on Windows).
This subsystem MUST NOT establish remote database network connections.
The system shall enforce role-based authorization for protected endpoints.
The system shall recommend one "best next action" to improve readiness (e.g., request clarification, assign verification, merge duplicate, resolve conflict).
The embedded VLC HTTP server MUST listen strictly on 127.0.0.1 and never bind to 0.0.0.0 or external network adapters.
The system shall update the relevant book availability and loan record when a borrowing request is approved.
The system shall support secure configuration and deployment practices.
The user shall be able to use a travel flight planner or calendar integration.
The system shall store COP updates as versioned artifacts and preserve the set of supporting COP Candidates and evidence packs used for each version.
The system shall detect encoding and repair malformed Unicode where possible.
Given the same sources and config, EnvLens shall produce deterministic diagnostics.
Users shall be able to book one-way, round-trip, or multi-city flights.
The library shall support Python ≥ 3.11.
Any reveal operation must be user-initiated.
The System shall support Credit/Debit Cards and Mobile Wallets.
Authentication and authorization shall be enforced by the backend.
Administrators shall be able to manage service categories.
API endpoints shall be documented through OpenAPI documentation.
This subsystem MUST NOT retain off-screen heavy DOM nodes (such as uncompressed high-resolution backdrops) in memory during rapid scrolling.
Break-the-glass access shall require a non-blank clinical reason, optional re-MFA, and shall be time-boxed to 1 hour and audited.
The System UI shall be user-friendly and support both mobile and desktop users.
EnvLens shall infer required variables from example/template files.
System shall optimize content descriptions for display contexts
Invalid credentials must not grant access.
This subsystem MUST NOT scrape third-party websites or pirate streaming sites.
BankAccount.withdraw shall raise a InsufficientFundsError if amount exceeds the current balance.
The audit log shall be tamper-evident via a SHA-256 hash chain.
A key without value shall be marked as inherited or unresolved.
The TUI shall include an in-app help screen.
The profiler shall produce a compact planner summary.
Users shall be able to use a travel planner or calendar integration.
The loss estimator shall calculate four information-loss dimensions.
This subsystem MUST NOT perform remote network operations or cloud profile synchronization.
The system shall configure ACC_RANGE (±4g) and verify the write via read-back before proceeding.
The system shall capture audio input from a microphone.
The following permissions must be enforced by the backend.
The system shall suggest likely duplicates and related threads for each backlog item and COP Candidate, and provide a merge workflow.
Test framework must generate comprehensive reports automatically.
The interface shall provide clear loading, success, empty, and error states for major request workflows.
All core actions must be usable without a mouse.
Raw records shall not be sent to a hosted model service as a required part of processing.
The system shall expose FHIR R4 read endpoints for the Patient resource and $everything bundle.
Recovery attempts shall be individually distinguishable in logs (which tier, which attempt number, success/failure).
Only a librarian or an admin with the required permission shall perform approval, rejection and return operations.
Book records shall remain stored after an application restart or redeployment.
Diagnoses shall be coded in ICD-10; lab results in LOINC; prescriptions may carry RxNorm codes.
Tests must be independent and clean up after themselves.
The system shall send the transcribed text to a locally-hosted LLM and receive a text response.
The system shall support six clinical roles with deny-by-default access.
Invariant I-03 (History Invariance on Move): File path migrations resulting from folder renames MUST NOT reset watch_count, last_position, or associated History records.
EnvLens shall provide non-interactive output for CI or scripting.
The system shall handle errors gracefully and provide meaningful error messages.
No event shall be recorded in this case.
Ingested message data and vector embeddings shall be retained only as long as configured by the workspace administrator.
Rail-enable logic for the PMIC shall be implemented once as a generic, reusable primitive rather than duplicated per rail.
The system shall allow an authenticated user to log out and end the current application session according to the implemented token strategy.
System shall generate category linkage SQL
API request and response bodies shall use JSON where applicable.
EnvLens shall accept a target directory.
Users shall be able to personalize filters based on travel purpose or profile.
The system shall maintain a central patient registry identified by a unique National Health ID (NHID).
The system shall maintain an immutable audit log of COP Candidate status changes, risk overrides, merges, role changes, and COP publish actions.
The system shall animate the robot's eyes and mouth during speech output.
The system shall allow users to search books by title or author.
All parsing and diagnostics must happen locally.
Secret-like values must never be shown in full by default.
The system shall run on Raspberry Pi OS (64-bit) and be portable to other Linux-based ARM platforms.
Delta commits shall preserve prior versions.
Regression tests must be mandatory for any bug fix.
The system shall generate a "What changed since last COP" summary (new items, status changes, resolved items).
For high-stakes in-review items, the system shall include a suggested recheck time and next verification step in the draft wording.
The system shall isolate malformed or ragged records.
The session password MUST be cleared from process memory immediately upon VLC termination.
The load operation shall accept an optional after_version parameter (default 0).
Saving a new snapshot shall not delete or alter any previously stored events.
The system shall respond to a student's question within 5 seconds (end-to-end) under normal conditions.
API roles shall restrict cleaning, audit retrieval, and rollback operations.
Platform-specific timing primitives shall be isolated behind a single header, not scattered through driver logic.
The system shall assign each registered account one global role: student, librarian or admin.
This subsystem MUST NOT block native worker threads during image download or network retry backoff loops.

The system shall support at least three configurable roles: General Participant (no system interaction required), Facilitator/Moderator (backlog access, promote, publish, override), and Verifier (record verification actions and evidence).
This subsystem MUST NOT store or transmit user viewing histories to external servers.
The system shall provide an I2C bus scanner (i2c_scan()) for bring-up diagnostics, enumerating all responding addresses in the 0x08–0x77 range.
The frontend and backend must communicate through REST APIs.
The system shall return a single book by its ID.
The Users shall be able to view flight info including seat availability and prices.
The system shall detect whether the spoken language is English or Urdu.
The system shall play the generated speech through a speaker.
